topic: Edward Deci University of Rochester Puzzle Cube Experiment: How Piece-Rate Cash Rewards Undermine Intrinsic Motivation and Dampen Striatal Valuation
act5_climax_episode: Follow-up MRI brain-scanning replication showing that once performance pay stops, spontaneous reward activity in the nucleus accumbens and striatum drops below unpaid peers during solitary play.
